name: JTR Series Lead-Free Hot Air Reflow Oven

items: Reinforced main hanging bracket to avoid rail deformation and board jamming
Multi-layer thermal insulation design. The surface temperature of the oven body is reduced by 10 to 20 degrees, effectively reducing the temperature of the working environment
New cooling configuration to make the filtered or reclaimed air back to oven chamber, reducing thermal loss and improving flux collection
15% heat transferring efficiency improvement to handle the lead-free process with more complicated and larger products
The dual-rails conveyor improves production efficiency as well as saves power and cost
Full protection of the sealed oven design to prevent nitrogen loss, achieving the lowest concentration of oxygen down to 150ppm
Nitrogen consumption is only 20-22M³/H with the oxygen level at 300-800ppm
Nitrogen construction is optional: High precision & reliable oxygen analyzer + cooling water, reducing solder, avoiding bridging, and achieving good welding quality
